recentItems.title: Europe vs American Big Tech: Is the US already dominating the EU? | The Dip Podcast
recentItems.description:
Is Europe too dependent on American tech companies? From cloud services and AI infrastructure to email and data storage, much of Europe's digital economy runs on technology controlled by US firms. At the same time, China is becoming an increasingly powerful competitor.
 
In this episode of The Dip, DW's Kassandra Sundt speaks with Proton COO Raphael Auphan and EuroStack Initiative chair Cristina Caffarra about digital sovereignty, Big Tech dominance, Europe's investment gap, AI, cloud infrastructure and whether European technology companies can realistically compete with Google, Microsoft, Amazon and China's rising tech champions. #dwbusiness #dwdip

recentItems.title: US says it hit three tankers after Iran attacked warships | DW News
recentItems.description:
The US military says it struck three Iranian oil tankers after two of its warships were targeted by Tehran. Washington says the vessels were part of a shadow network that helps fund Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps, the IRGC, and its regional proxies. Fighting between the US and Iran has flared up again in recent days after several weeks of relative calm.

recentItems.title: Far-right AfD leads polls ahead of crucial Saxony-Anhalt state election in Germany | DW News
recentItems.description:
It’s the final day of campaigning ahead of a crucial state election in Germany that could give the far right a mandate to govern for the first time. Germany’s far-right Alternative for Germany is heading into Sunday’s Saxony-Anhalt election with a strong lead in the polls, even though authorities have designated the party’s state branch as anti-constitutional and a far-right extremist group. Rival parties have ruled out working with the AfD, while nearly a third of voters remain undecided.

recentItems.title: The three issues standing in the way of peace in Ukraine | DW News
recentItems.description:
Donald Trump says he has a new idea for ending Russia's war in Ukraine. But any peace proposal faces fundamental disagreements between Moscow and Kyiv that go far beyond what Trump calls a "personality problem" between Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are holding talks with Moscow and Kyiv as Russia and Ukraine continue to exchange long-range attacks and remain deeply divided over the terms of any settlement.
So what are the biggest obstacles to a deal?
Russia expert Mark Galeotti joins DW to count down what he sees as the three most important sticking points.
 
#ukrainerussiawar #dwcurrentaffairs
